Class NotificationRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventparticipation.universal.NotificationRepository
public class NotificationRepository extends Object
Repository for reading and updating entrant notifications.

Status model used by regular event invitation actions:

  • selectionStatus: waiting / selected / cancelled
  • responseStatus: pending / accepted / declined
  • finalStatus: enrolled

Co-organizer invitations are handled separately from regular event invitations. A co-organizer invitation must be accepted before the entrant is actually promoted to co-organizer and removed from the waitlist.

    • sendCoOrganizerInvitation

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<NotificationRepository.CoOrganizerInvitationResult> sendCoOrganizerInvitation(String entrantId, String eventId, String eventName)
      Sends a co-organizer invitation if there is no pending invitation yet for the same entrant and event.

      Behavior:

      • If no invitation document exists, create a pending invitation.
      • If a pending invitation already exists, do not overwrite it.
      • If an old invitation exists but is accepted or declined, overwrite it with a fresh pending invitation.

      This method is idempotent for the pending state because it uses a fixed notification document id per entrant and event.

      Parameters:
      entrantId - entrant receiving the invitation
      eventId - target event id
      eventName - target event name
      Returns:
      task containing the send result

    • acceptCoOrganizerInvitation

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void> acceptCoOrganizerInvitation(String entrantId, NotificationItem item)
      Accepts a co-organizer invitation.

      On acceptance:

      • entrant id is added to events/{eventId}.coOrganizerIds
      • entrant is removed from events/{eventId}/waitlist/{entrantId}
      • notification action status becomes accepted

      This is separate from acceptInvitation(String, NotificationItem) because accepting a co-organizer invitation does not enroll the entrant into the event.

      Parameters:
      entrantId - entrant id
      item - notification being accepted
      Returns:
      task completing when the transaction finishes

    • sendPrivateInvitation

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<NotificationRepository.CoOrganizerInvitationResult> sendPrivateInvitation(String entrantId, String eventId, String eventName)
      Sends a private event invitation notification if no pending invitation already exists for this entrant and event.

      Behaviour mirrors sendCoOrganizerInvitation(String, String, String): if a pending invite already exists it is left untouched; if an old accepted / declined invite exists it is overwritten with a fresh pending one.

      Parameters:
      entrantId - entrant receiving the invite
      eventId - target event id
      eventName - target event name
      Returns:
      task containing the send result

    • addPrivateInviteNotificationToBatch

      public static void addPrivateInviteNotificationToBatch(com.google.firebase.firestore.WriteBatch batch, com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore db, String entrantId, String eventId, String eventName)
      Adds a private invite notification to an existing write batch using a fixed document id (idempotent within the batch).

      For full duplicate-safe sending prefer sendPrivateInvitation(String, String, String).

      Parameters:
      batch - write batch to add the operation to
      db - firestore instance
      entrantId - entrant receiving the invite
      eventId - target event id
      eventName - target event name
